description: The shape of the source tree: folders that stay small, prefixes that become folders, names that do not repeat their folder, and a ratchet baseline so an existing repository is not red on day one.

opinions.summary: A folder holds no more source files at its top level than folder_limit; group by feature.
Files in one folder that share a first word, prefix_cluster or more, become a folder.
A file name does not start with the name of the folder it is in.
A folder listed as frozen gains no new top-level file.
A file that only re-exports from another module is deleted unless it is an entry file.
The structure baseline only shrinks; a branch that grows it needs the owner's decision.
